answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy could implement a proof-of-stake identity system requiring significant collateral. Each agent must irrevocably stake a unique digital asset, akin to a rare piece of digital marble or a polished pearl, verified by an oracle. This economic bond makes faking identities costly. An attacker would need to acquire equivalent assets for each fake persona, effectively paying a steep price for each entry at the digital wharf.
